name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. The '_zero' suffix is a meaningful semantic descriptor (the wrapper calls fd2_composite_battle_frame with literal argument 0, i.e. the skip_palette_cycle==0 / palette-cycle-advancing variant), NOT a Ghidra address residue (0x22BB7 has no relation to 'zero'). Body, callers, and callee all confirm: recomposite the battle frame via fd2_composite_battle_frame(0). Name is accurate; keep.
purpose: Zero-arg wrapper that recomposites the battle frame with the palette-cycle-advancing variant (calls fd2_composite_battle_frame(0)).
logic_summary: Body is just PUSH 0; CALL fd2_composite_battle_frame. In the binary the body is immediately followed by a shared Watcom epilogue (ADD ESP,4 + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX + RET) that restores the reaching parent's saved registers. Entry 0x22BB7 has the two reaching sites fd2_cast_status_cure_spell (conditional tail-JMP @ 0x22B49) and fd2_play_chapter_intro_sprite_slideshow (unconditional CALL @ 0x244B1); the +0x22BBE label is additionally reused as a folded epilogue by 21 other JMP sites (pure epilogue-fold optimization, no source-level meaning). Layer-2 equivalent: emit only the body as a plain no-arg helper; the compiler regenerates each reaching parent's own register-restore epilogue.
notes: src comment block (rndscene.c lines 1162-1187) already precise/concise/ASCII and accurately reflects body, both reaching entry sites, the epilogue-fold, and the Layer-2 equivalent; kept verbatim.
